name: Non-product state implies state readout
description: Exercise 2.149: prove SZ = OZ and RZ = ID(SZ) when SZ is not a Cartesian product and RZ is properly aligned projective. Canonical proof in Wymore.lean.

elements.text: SZ = OZ under non-product state and properly aligned projective readout.
RZ = ID(SZ) (state readout) under the same hypotheses.
